app.title: OpenDLSS: A Vulkan Reimplementation of Nvidia's DLSS 5 Neural Rendering Network
app.author: sagacity
app.description: A Vulkan-based implementation of Nvidia DLSS 5, enabling hardware‑independent neural rendering.
proposed_tests: Clone the repo and build the shared library with CMake
Run the included sample application with a test texture
Measure the frame time and compare with a baseline Vulkan renderer without DLSS
Validate output image against a reference image for correctness
